attrs.author: Voyage AI by MongoDB
attrs.summary: voyage-4-nano is a state-of-the-art text embedding model from Voyage AI, designed for high-performance semantic search and retrieval. Built on a bidirectional Qwen3 backbone (~340M params, 32k context). Supports Matryoshka Representation Learning with embedding dimensions of 2048, 1024, 512, or 256. Multilingual. Apache 2.0.
